title: Taking Tokenization Mainstream | Franklin Templeton, SBI, Baker McKenzie, & Chainlink at SFF 2025
description:
At Singapore Fintech Festival 2025, leaders from Franklin Templeton, SBI Digital Markets, Baker McKenzie, and Chainlink discuss how clear legal frameworks and cross-chain infrastructure are accelerating the adoption of tokenization.

Panelists:
• Matthew French, Global Program Manager, Digital Assets, Franklin Templeton
• CK Ong, Chief Operating Officer, SBI Digital Markets
• Stephanie Magnus, Partner and Global Head of Fintech, Baker McKenzie
• Niki Ariyasinghe, Head of Business Development, Asia-Pacific and Middle East, Chainlink Labs 

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

potential_elements.text: Taking Tokenization Mainstream | Franklin Templeton, SBI, Baker McKenzie, & Chainlink at SFF 2025

At Singapore Fintech Festival 2025, leaders from Franklin Templeton, SBI Digital Markets, Baker McKenzie, and Chainlink discuss how clear legal frameworks and cross-chain infrastructure are accelerating the adoption of tokenization. Panelists: • Matthew French, Global Program Manager, Digital Assets, Franklin Templeton • CK Ong, Chief Operating Officer, SBI Digital Markets • Stephanie Magnus, Partner and Global Head of Fintech, Baker McKenzie • Niki Ariyasinghe, Head of Business Development, Asia-Pacific and Middle East, Chainlink Labs Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve.
